verification.command: initial current-truth and Phase 5 plan review
verification.summary: Confirmed the synchronous legacy path, reusable canonical Resolver/Profile and stat_snapshot_v1 boundaries, and the absence of any async snapshot store, worker, endpoint or frontend polling path.

Authority, signature, transaction, concurrency, fencing, recovery, backpressure, privacy, compatibility, performance, deployment and rollback boundaries are explicit with no unresolved product decision.
35 pure signature, bounded snapshot, single-flight, limits, cooldown, lease, fencing, immutable content-hash, bounded health and migration contract tests passed.
745 existing WebSim serializer, PG cache and backend route/health compatibility tests passed.
173 existing frontend page, API transport and Harness tests passed.
Full profile passed 388 Node tests, 1308 Python tests with 1 skipped, compileall, 130 JSON/syntax/Harness/diff commands and Strict Harness.

smoke.summary: Real wow_app repository transaction proved queued pending, duplicate single-flight reuse, SKIP LOCKED claim, heartbeat, stale-token rejection, verified publication and exact hash reload; the transaction then rolled back to zero snapshot/job/worker rows.

timerBackflow.summary: Slice 5A installs no worker or timer. Candidate deploy kept WOW_DEPLOY_START_ASYNC_SYNCS=0, did not trigger Phase 4 refresh, and left the new snapshot/job/worker tables at zero operational rows after transactional smoke.

candidateDeployment.rollbackTarget: stop future consumers if any, restore code to 1e4b549, retain additive dormant 0015 tables, and use the recorded wow_test dump only for corruption recovery

runtimeEvidence.detail: Migration 0015 applied after the recorded backup. All four tables and six indexes exist; the active-signature partial unique predicate is present. wow_app has SELECT/INSERT only on immutable snapshots, SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on jobs/worker state/metrics, and no DELETE grants.

Using the deployed repository with the real application PostgreSQL environment, a miss returned pending, a duplicate reused the same job, claim returned running, heartbeat succeeded, stale token publication was rejected, the valid token published and reloaded the exact content hash, and rollback restored snapshots/jobs/workers to 0/0/0.

The first real repository claim exposed an ambiguous unqualified job_id in UPDATE FROM RETURNING. The transaction rolled back with zero rows and no pointer impact. A focused red test was added, RETURNING columns were qualified with the job alias, and the final real repository transaction passed at 2b98dbe.

SHA-256 parity matched between the candidate worktree and /opt/wow-mini-program for gear_stat_snapshot.py, gear_stat_snapshot_store.py and migration 0015; the final store hash after the SQL correction is ed5d582277b8c0252e56ad8639a14c28529de50756d49f60ef1e2ecb66d3dd76.

Candidate deploy preserved generation 9. Public matrix passed 40/40 with zero failures, 11 resolved Profiles and 29 truthful blockers; malformed/stale/missing-item/unknown-Catalyst remained 400/409/503 fail-closed and legacy Profile remained non-empty.

wow-backend remained active with NRestarts=0, MemoryCurrent 103936000 and MemoryPeak 104509440 bytes. No systemd units failed, backend warning count since final candidate deploy was zero, async sync stayed disabled, and Phase 4 refresh state remained manual_required without a new deploy-triggered run.

risks.detail: Signature includes server profile hash and the explicit revision vector; client-supplied signatures are never trusted.
Partial unique single-flight, SKIP LOCKED claim and lock-token fencing are mandatory before activation.
Migration is additive and tables remain dormant in 5A; normal rollback is code/config, not destructive schema removal.
Route, worker, frontend cutover and Phase 6 Catalyst are explicitly excluded from Slice 5A.

summary: Phase 5A candidate is live-verified at implementation commit 2b98dbe as a dormant pure signature plus additive PostgreSQL snapshot/job repository slice. Migration backup/apply, least privileges, real single-flight claim/heartbeat/fencing/publication rollback transaction, runtime parity, public compatibility, health/service/log and Phase 6 fail-closed evidence passed. No route, worker, frontend behavior or Catalyst capability is active.
